bass.tags: Funk rock. An electric bass guitar plays a repetitive, syncopated slap-and-pop riff featuring rapid sixteenth-note ghost notes and percussive thumps. The bass tone is bright with a mid-range boost and slight compression. A drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and a tight, dry kick drum. The tempo is 105 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the percussive bass line and the steady drum groove.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[slap electric bass riff starts, syncopated sixteenth notes]
[dry kick drum and crisp snare enter with a steady backbeat]

[Main Section]
[bass continues with percussive ghost notes and pops]
[drums maintain consistent 4/4 groove]

drums.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid down-stroked power chords in a constant eighth-note rhythm. The bass guitar follows the guitar progression with a heavily overdriven tone. Drums feature a fast d-beat pattern with a prominent, dry snare and constant eighth-note hi-hat hits. Vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery and minimal melodic variation. The track maintains a consistent 180 BPM in the key of E minor. The production is lo-fi with a narrow stereo field and high-mid frequency emphasis on the guitars. Transitions are marked by brief drum fills consisting of rapid snare rolls and crash cymbal accents.
drums.prompt:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar power chords, d-beat drums enter]

[Verse 1]
[shouted male vocals]
Systematic failure [snare roll]
Crushing all the hope inside
Walls are closing in on us
Nowhere left for us to hide

[Chorus]
[bass guitar distortion increases]
Break the chains (break the chains)
Rise above the lies
Break the chains (break the chains)
See through their disguise [crash cymbal]

[Bridge]
[half-time drum feel, chugging guitar rhythm]
They control the narrative
They control the mind
Leave the past behind

[Outro]
[tempo accelerates]
Go! Go! Go! Go!
[feedback swell, abrupt stop]

vocals.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play a palm-muted, syncopated riff in E minor. The drum kit features a prominent double-kick pedal pattern and a bright, cutting snare. A distorted bass guitar follows the guitar riff exactly. The tempo is 140 BPM in 4/4 time. The production uses a dry, close-mic sound for the drums and high-gain saturation on the guitars. The arrangement consists of a rhythmic instrumental loop with no melodic lead or vocal presence.
vocals.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, palm-muted eighth notes]
[double-kick drum pattern enters]

[Main Section]
[distorted bass guitar enters, doubling guitar riff]
[snare hits on beats 2 and 4]
[crash cymbal accents on the downbeat of every four bars]
